capabilities: Send the active note to p2pclaw.com pre-filled as a paper topic
Open the PaperClaw dashboard in the browser
Publish the current note from a ribbon icon or command
disambiguation: Not a citation manager or academic-writing assistant; the note is submitted to an external site where the review and formatting happen.
extras: The README warns that AI-generated scientific content still needs source checking and author review, and the plugin listing carries an unreviewed-by-Obsidian-staff notice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand a note to an external AI peer-review and academic-formatting service without copying text between tools.

relations.evidence: PaperClaw is part of the OpenCLAW-P2P ecosystem

summary: Sends the active note to p2pclaw.com, where an AI peer-review and formatting pipeline turns it into a research paper.
